verificationSelection.riskAnalysis: T03 R03 was already independently approved, but CAP-03.S02-INTEGRATION-R01-F01 proved that its accepted-intent policy could not be reached through the packaged native principal boundary. The credible revalidation risks are policy evaluation against a renderer-local, draft, stale, or rolled-back revision; response-loss replay creating split authority or duplicate audit; bypass of one of six mode gates; audit failure returning an unaudited decision; native/package capability drift; test-only supervisor authority leaking into production; and stale scanner evidence. The required prior-candidate range also contains immutable T02 R05 and adverse slice evidence plus generated planning projections, so the exact selector conservatively identifies broader evidence-control paths already independently reviewed. R04 therefore replays the incremental service/security/native/package/generated-client/renderer union, the real protected vertical, live supply chain, quality/architecture/contracts, zero-UI delta, planning integrity, build provenance, and witness safety without restarting unrelated historical audits. No T03 policy code, migration, dependency, public payload, experience authority, or external boundary changed. Controlled slice visual evidence, privileged symlink equivalence, exact-clean performance, and the complete cross-capability/platform matrix remain owned by the strict-descendant slice review or W1 exit.
